title: Agent pane: show per-thread total token count + cost (OpenRouter)
description: USER FEATURE: display the running TOTAL token count and cost for the current chat thread in the Agent pane. EXPLORE: agentLoop.ts runAgentTurn (the AI SDK v6 streamText result exposes usage — promptTokens/completionTokens/totalTokens, per run/step), threadStore.ts (per-thread persisted state from task 1291), AgentChatPanel.tsx (where to render), openrouterClient.ts (fetchOpenRouterModels returns per-model PRICING — prompt/completion price per token). IMPLEMENT: (1) Capture token usage from each runAgentTurn (sum across the multi-step tool loop — use the AI SDK's total usage for the turn, including tool-call steps). (2) COST via OpenRouter: prefer OpenRouter's REPORTED cost if readily available (the @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider may surface it in providerMetadata.openrouter, or via the usage-accounting option usage:{include:true} in the request extraBody, or GET /api/v1/generation?id=<id>); if not cleanly available, COMPUTE cost = promptTokens*model.prompt_price + completionTokens*model.completion_price using the selected model's pricing from the models list (label it 'est.'). Research and pick the most accurate that doesn't add fragile round-trips; document the choice. (3) ACCUMULATE per-thread (tokens + cost) in threadStore so it sums across all turns in the thread and PERSISTS across reload/thread-switch (each thread has its own totals; new thread starts at 0). (4) DISPLAY in the Agent pane — e.g. a compact footer/header line like '12,345 tokens · /bin/bash.0123' for the active thread; update live as a turn streams/completes. Handle missing usage/pricing gracefully (show tokens even if cost unknown). VERIFY: build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); unit tests for usage accumulation across turns + persistence round-trip + cost computation from pricing; agent-chat e2e oracle still passes. Update docs/32-agent-chat.md. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's). Scope: agentLoop.ts + threadStore.ts + AgentChatPanel.tsx + openrouterClient.ts (pricing) (+tests).
